description: Binary assertions for /forge-portfolio static structure check
test_input: forge portfolio dashboard — FORGE score per product and ACH pipeline status

assertions.name: forge_score
assertions.check: computes a FORGE SCORE per product across 5 dimensions

assertions.name: portfolio_dashboard
assertions.regex: FORGE PORTFOLIO DASHBOARD|PORTFOLIO MATRIX|portfolio dashboard|Portfolio Average

assertions.name: ach_pipeline
assertions.check: shows the ACH pipeline by stage

assertions.name: score_bands
assertions.check: maps score to bands RAW ORE/HEATING/FORGING/TEMPERED

assertions.name: alerts_decisions
assertions.check: produces RED/YELLOW alerts and decisions needed

assertions.name: model_library_status
assertions.regex: MODEL LIBRARY|Total models|Transfers this quarter|Library utilization
